definitions.explanation: Tuna preserved in a can, a staple pantry item in Japanese households. Used in a wide variety of dishes from salads and rice balls to pasta and sandwiches.

examples.japanese: ツナ{缶|かん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a salad with canned tuna.

examples.japanese: ツナ{缶|かん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦おにぎり→おにぎり：04956_onigiri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Canned tuna is popular as a rice ball filling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{非常食|ひじょうしょく}→非常食：18765_hijoushoku⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ツナ{缶|かん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何個|なんこ}→何個：26687_nanko⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{常備|じょうび}→常備：27113_joubi⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I always keep several cans of tuna at home as emergency food.

notes:
One of the most common canned foods in Japan. The word combines the loanword ⟦ツナ→ツナ：09957_tsuna⟧ (tuna, from English) with ⟦{缶|かん}→缶：01076_kan⟧ (can). Japan is one of the world's largest consumers of canned tuna, and it appears in an enormous range of everyday dishes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ツナ{缶|かん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open a can of tuna
- ツナ{缶|かん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{油|あぶら}を{切|き}る→油を切る：22553_aburawokiru⟧: to drain the oil from canned tuna
- ノンオイル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ツナ{缶|かん}: oil-free canned tuna
- ツナマヨ: tuna mayo (abbreviation of ツナマヨネーズ)

USAGE:
In Japan, the brand name シーチキン (Sea Chicken) by Hagoromo Foods is so widely known that many people use it interchangeably with ツナ{缶|かん}, similar to how "Band-Aid" is used for adhesive bandages in English.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{缶詰|かんづめ}→缶詰：00187_kanzume⟧: canned food (general term)
- ⟦{鮭缶|さけかん}→鮭缶：29516_sakekan⟧: canned salmon
